text: Independent native-Windows verification of flop-labs/tclk PR #155 at exact head 2a2c4366eedaad243b2e5a37cb9b6462d6e364b4 (base/main 5cc4ab93efbc8999a3a7e1471b639deca25998ea): TCLK SPEC §2 says frame.from MUST match the transport-verified sender. Current main's mcp/src/tools.ts decodes tclk_post_frame input but does not enforce that binding before posting; the PR adds requireSigner for both caller-signed and server-signed paths before any request. On Node 24.18.0/Corepack pnpm 11.25.0, both packages built, MCP tests passed 42/42 and worker tests 33/33, including two zero-request mismatch cases. Root tests were 103/104; the sole failure was the already tracked Windows CRLF generated-file freshness issue (#90/#121), not this change. GitHub currently shows no reviews or check runs. Scope: synthetic/fake transport only; no hosted frame, contract, rail, wallet, token, or funds. Evidence: https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk/pull/155
